probe_detail.name: Signals direct consequence for the reader's own life
Withholds exactly the detail the headline makes the reader want

final.name: Practical personal utility
final.audit_justification: Usable consequences for readers are substantive information that can directly motivate genuine interest in a story.

final.name: Emotional arousal
final.audit_justification: Emotion conveyed by the event or framing is genuine evidence of the headline's capacity to attract reader interest.

final.name: Cultural touchstone
final.audit_justification: Recognizable cultural references are principally subject-matter markers, although broad cultural salience may also make the underlying story genuinely appealing.
final.arbiter_reason: Invoking a recognizable cultural object is fundamentally a topic marker that signals an existing audience interest, rather than evidence of the construct's underlying substance. While these references signal broad social salience, they act as a packaging cue that travels with reader interest rather than measuring the intrinsic appeal of the text itself.

final.name: Personal consequence
final.audit_justification: Consequences for ordinary readers are substantive stakes that plausibly drive deliberate reading choices.

final.name: Quoted first-person voice
final.audit_justification: First-person quotation is a packaging and punctuation pattern, though the personal narrative behind it may also provide genuine human interest.

final.name: Goal Conflict
final.audit_justification: Explicit conflict communicates substantive tension and uncertainty that can make a story genuinely compelling.

final.name: Expectation Reversal
final.audit_justification: A meaningful reversal conveys surprising substantive information rather than merely identifying a production convention.

final.name: Punchy single quote marker
final.audit_justification: A short single-quote construction is primarily a punctuation and packaging template, although the quoted reaction may carry genuine emotional force.

final.name: CURIOSITY GAP
final.audit_justification: An unresolved concrete question is a substantive informational incentive to read when it is neither vague nor deceptive.

final.name: International place-name density
final.audit_justification: The number of geographic names is a topic and location proxy with no inherent connection to the headline's substantive appeal.

final.name: Bizarre Novelty Contrast
final.audit_justification: An unexpected combination communicates genuine novelty or surprise that can directly stimulate reader interest.

final.name: Direct Pronoun Posessive Hook
final.audit_justification: Leading with a possessive or first-person pronoun is a packaging fingerprint, though it can arise from genuinely engaging personal testimony.
final.arbiter_reason: Leading with a first-person pronoun is a formatting fingerprint that indicates a specific genre of personal narrative packaging. Although this stylistic choice travels with engaging human-interest testimony, the instruction measures this surface boilerplate rather than the genuine narrative substance.

final.name: Evidence or reveal cue
final.audit_justification: A promise of evidence, verification, or revelation communicates substantive informational value that can reasonably drive readership.

final.name: Ominous but vague future threat
final.audit_justification: A prospective threat is substantive risk framing that can cause reader concern and curiosity even when its details remain vague.

final.name: Plain-language accessibility
final.audit_justification: Clear and accessible language genuinely improves readers' ability to understand the story's relevance and content.

final.name: TABLOID FRAME OR PLAYFUL PUN
final.audit_justification: Shortness, puns, and playful references are stylistic packaging markers, although skilled and apt phrasing may also make a headline genuinely more engaging.
final.arbiter_reason: Evaluating word count and puns explicitly targets stylistic packaging markers and format constraints rather than intrinsic reader interest. While apt phrasing can make a headline genuinely more engaging, these traits primarily act as recognizable style fingerprints that travel with the construct.

final.name: Headline length
final.audit_justification: Headline length is explicitly a format proxy rather than a measure of substantive reader interest.

final.name: Explanatory promise
final.audit_justification: Promising a useful explanation identifies substantive information that readers can obtain by opening the article.

final.name: Analytical interrogative format
final.audit_justification: Opening with a question word is a template-level format marker, though it may reflect a genuinely valuable explanatory story.
final.upstream_parent: Editorial push for evergreen context or analysis pieces

final.name: Human-interest vocabulary
final.audit_justification: This vocabulary chiefly identifies a soft-news topic or desk template, although intimate human experiences can also possess genuine reader appeal.

final.name: VISUAL SCENEABILITY
final.audit_justification: The capacity to evoke a concrete scene is a meaningful communicative property that can make the underlying event easier to grasp and more compelling.

final.name: Regional geopolitics lexicon
final.audit_justification: Regional labels and stock institutional verbs are topic, geography, and venue-style fingerprints rather than evidence of substantive appeal.

final.name: Casual or sensational colloquialism
final.audit_justification: Informal or sensational word choice is primarily a stylistic marker, though vivid language can sometimes communicate genuine drama or emotional intensity.

final.name: Playful or quirky phrasing
final.audit_justification: Puns, alliteration, and idioms are editorial-style signals, although skillful phrasing may also make the communicated story genuinely engaging.
final.upstream_parent: Editorial curation and audience engagement strategy

final.name: Story sequence marker
final.audit_justification: Day counts and continuity phrases are temporal and sequence templates, though they may occur because an ongoing story has genuine established reader interest.
